notes:
## 0.9.5-beta.11
- Dashboard: the panels now flow into as many columns as fit instead of always two, and the page stops widening at about 2200 pixels, so it no longer stretches on an ultrawide monitor.

## 0.9.5-beta.10
- Daily Entries: a long task name now wraps onto two lines instead of stretching the whole table. If a name needs more than two lines, the task column widens just enough to bring it back to two, and the table scrolls sideways if that is wider than the window.

## 0.9.5-beta.9
- Jira ticket lookups (the search button on Daily Entries, the ticket search on Notes and the meeting ticket prompt) now share one list. It scrolls when it is long, so the window no longer runs off the screen when you search with nothing typed.
- Time tickets are now behind a Show time tickets tick box instead of filling the list.
- Tickets that are past development no longer show in these lookups: Ready for Agile QA, All Dev Done, ready for integration testing, QA Onsite testing, Agile Test Only, Done and the like. Ready for QA Demo is the latest that still shows, and Resolved still shows because that work needs logging. A ticket you search for by its key always shows.
- On Daily Entries, tickets that already have an entry today are left out of the lookup, with a note saying how many.

## 0.9.5-beta.8
- Sprint Planning: the Open PR button now also shows on tickets that are in progress, not only in the pull request column, because some ticket types can't be moved to Ready for PR but still have a pull request.

## 0.9.5-beta.7
- Sprint Planning and the Dashboard: the story points expected by now now allow for support. The sprint's working days are split between support (the points kept for it, or the time it has really taken if that is more) and everything else, and the planned points are spread over what is left. Time already spent on support no longer counts as time that should have gone into the planned points, so a sprint with a lot of support no longer shows as behind just because of it.

## 0.9.5-beta.6
- Notes: the notes now flow into several columns on a wide window instead of each stretching across the whole width.

## 0.9.5-beta.5
- Sprint Planning: the points and settings box, the progress box and the ticket search now sit side by side on a wide window instead of each stretching across the whole width.

## 0.9.5-beta.4
- TimeLogger is now called Workbench in the app: the window title, sidebar, About page, update messages and notifications. The installer, Start menu entry, data folder and update feed keep the old name for now, so updating and your saved data are not affected.
- Submit Time no longer stretches across a wide window; it keeps a readable width in the middle again. The other pages still fill the window.

## 0.9.5-beta.3
- Sprint Planning: a ticket in the pull request column (such as Ready for PR) now has an Open PR button when GitHub is connected and a pull request names the ticket in its title, description or branch. It opens an open pull request if there is one, otherwise the most recent. A ticket with no match shows no button.
- Sprint Planning: removed the status text beside Notes on each ticket, since the column already says it.

## 0.9.5-beta.2
- Pages now use the full width of the window instead of stopping at a fixed width in the middle. On Sprint Planning the board columns, such as Done, now sit side by side as the window gets wider instead of wrapping onto another row. Daily Entries and the Calendar widen the same way, and the pull request cards (on Pull Requests and Daily Scrum) and the Support Tickets cards flow into several columns on a wide window.
